title: The Birthday Cake
answer: C, the brother. He said he never went near the cake, but his sleeve was covered in the cake's pink frosting.

beats.line: Uncle Rob was found dead at his own birthday party, right next to the cake.
The party was loud, and nobody saw a thing.
Suspect A. The baker says she left right after delivering the cake.
Suspect B. The best friend says she was dancing all night.
Suspect C. The brother says he doesn't eat sweets, and never went near the cake.
But the detective noticed the brother's sleeve. It was covered in pink frosting.
So, who's lying? A, B, or C?
Comment your answer. The solution is in the pinned comment.
